title: Language Development
summary: Language development: theories of language acquisition (Chomsky's LAD/innateness vs Skinner's behaviourist view), milestones and the critical period.
objectives: Describe Chomsky's LAD and Skinner's behaviourist view.
revision: Language development: Chomsky's LAD vs Skinner's behaviourist view, milestones, critical period.
traps: Chomsky = innate LAD; Skinner = learned via reinforcement.
Critical period = early window for language.

notes.t: Noam Chomsky proposed an innate Language Acquisition Device — humans are biologically predisposed to acquire language.
B.F. Skinner proposed language is learned through operant conditioning — imitation, reinforcement and shaping.
A time window in early childhood when language acquisition occurs most easily; after this, learning becomes more difficult.
UGC NET frequently asks about Chomsky's LAD, Skinner's behaviourist view and the critical period.

mnemonics.title: LC
mnemonics.text: L — LAD/Chomsky (innate, biological), C — Conditioning/Skinner (learned, reinforcement)

flashcards.a: Language learned via imitation and reinforcement.
Early window for easy language learning.
